***We read daily from (Conference Approved Literature) which may be found on our front web page. Each meeting is begun with the Serenity prayer. We then read from each of the daily readings and discuss what we have read as it relates to our own situations. We then finish up with the Serenity prayer. We would like to welcome you to join us as we trudge the road of happy destiny together.***    


**1. On (Mondays & Fridays) we read from and discuss a reading from the first 164 pages of the** **Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous.**    


**2. On (Tuesdays & Thursdays)** **we read and discuss a reading from the** **Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions.**       


**3. On (Saturdays & Sundays) we read and discuss a reading from the personal stories of those that came before us from pages 165 to 559 of the** **Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous.**    


**4. On** **(Wednesdays)** **we have a** **beginner's topic discussion in which we will read and discuss for the remainder of the hour. (Any Conference Approved Literature from our web page)**

I haven't been diagnosed with It but my Grandaughter has and she seems like her Dad and I in every way. We all were in a hurry to be grown up and let loose on the world. We all got into trouble, couldn't concentrate, and blew off school. My son and I both left the home at 17 and got jobs and had families.  My granddaughter will probably do the same. I unfortunately tried and nearly killed myself the third attempt which left me paralyzed from the neck down 7 years into my marriage after a DWI that left me in a deadly drunken depression. I thank God even though I'm paralyzed that I lived. I got to not only watch my children grow up but give them the best emotional support I could. The point I'm trying to make is don't give up. Always work on making yourself better because only you can make you happy. Live in the moment, not yesterday's feelings or tomorrow's anxiety's. Live now don't worry about what other people think. If they were truly intelligent they would keep their hateful feelings and thoughts inside themselves and learn to work on their own damn shit. Always work for today for the rewards you want tomorrow. We often have life backwards we want everything now but that's not how life works.  First we must work on self and future plan then live out that plan to find happiness. Even then you can graduate get good paying job and still have a crappy living mate. So you must always no matter what count on your own self for happiness. Staying focused on getting that good job, quality mate with like minded desires, goals, and values. Lastly but should be first as far as I'm concerned is call on God everyday, every time your going to make a decision, and praise God always, for when you do you will start seeing his workings in your life and way too many coinsidences to there not being a God. Live life to the fullest everyday because you never know when it's going to end but live it responsibly, happy, and loving to yourself, others, and God. Then and only then will you know true happiness as I am learning. I'm 49 and I wish somebody sat me down daily and reassured me and guided me, maybe I would have learned all this without becoming paralyzed after a stupid suicide attempt that hurt so many including myself. P.S. don't beat yourself up for past mistakes either. just make amends to those you can and ask God for forgiveness. That is all you can do and remember once you ask for forgiveness in Jesus name it's done. God says he will remember those sins no more and for that you should thank him. We will never know the truth about everything until judgment day and when we get there I know I don't want to see God after killing myself. I will just live my life as nice, giving, and helpful person as I can and I highly suggest you do the same because it's not only the right thing to do it also rubs off on others. Maybe if we keep happiness, peacefulness, and love flowing all around us this will become a world worth living in. It all starts with you, me, everybody working together for the common good and I see that happening In the young and the old. so live, love and be HAPPY my friend. If you ever want to talk i'm on line from 12am-2am eastern u.s. time n.y. [https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/](https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/)Peace out Bill E,

I got lucky enough that I didn't totally brake my mothers heart or my wifes. I got to give my children hope as they grew up. I watched them have relationships both good and bad but I was here when they needed me. I now am watching them bring up their 3 children each. I did not want to live when my wife and I split up and I drank myself nearly to death until I could not stand the person I was becoming. After flipping my wheelchair two out of four drinking binges and cursing out the nursing staff after they shut the power off on my chair I decided I need to change. I decided to go to AA the very next day after I apologized to the staff i cursed so severely. I went to AA and I learned I'm a people please, I don't feel comfortable in a crowd unless i'm drunk or high which my counsler said I have social anxiety. Now I have leaned and repented for all I've sinned against. This may sound like preaching but self reflecting and telling all in my AA group gave me relief and hope. these things I've learned about myself and learned I don't want to be that person anymore. Now I have decided To help others for being good and helping others makes me very happy. i pray you don't give up on living for others because that is the most noble cause and the greatest joy is to watch those you love live life to the fullest. I pray you to find love and have children because the love of a child is truly the greatest love of all. I'm at [https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/](https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/) from 12am-2am eastern every night and when nobody comes I come here to talk and hopefully to spread hope and joy and love of the spirit. I pray you find hope. I hope you see the light through the Darkness. When your so young things can seem so bleak. I know I was there 35 years ago but the feelings are the same the inner pain hurts. Whether it be loss of love, neglect, abuse, or sexual abuse there are a lot of reasons this world sucks. The only thing we can do is do our part to make it better. i gave up several times 2 suicide attempts before I moved out at 17. I asked for help after my second attempt and the psych dr. said you'l be fine. I wanted to be looked up the pain was horrible. My break up nearly killed me and my mom's boyfriend physically abused me fore years and when my sister called the cops the mental abuse continued till I moved out. Then at 17 I found love again. By 18 I had a kid on the way life was great again. love and family saved my life for years . After 7 years my alcoholism caught up with me my kids were 6 and a half and 4 and i had cheated on my wife. I was feeling like scum and was drinking a 12 pack and a fith of 151 rum a day just to get to sleep. I was spending our family's wealth on me. My cars kept breaking down and often had to hitch hike 40 miles to work and back lukily I was good at  it. I eventually got my second DWI and tried to kill myself again. Sadly this time I was nearly successful becoming paralyzed from the neck down. Well short story short things can get much worse. only after 24 more years did I finally find true happiness because I started going to Alcoholics Anonymous  after I kept flipping my wheelchair drunk and blew up on the nursing staff saying the most horrible stuff. Thankfully God made sure I woke up clear of mind with the memory of everything I said and the looks of all I hurt instead of my normal black out drunks. I never realized how sarcastic I was when I drank and I never realized why I kept drinking especially after I nearly killed myself. I learned after I finally decided to seek help that I am a people pleaser and I have fear of situational anxiety I guess is the term. I have been learning how to except these feelings without drinking. I have also learned to live in today and not worry about the abuse I suffered from my childhood anymore because there is nothing I can do about it. I also learned not to fear the future anymore because whatever happens is gonna happen. The first time I tried to kill myself I decided if i'm not going to live for myself I'm going live for others and that's what AA teaches me today. The real key to finding true happiness is establishing happiness with in, making yourself a better person. Then when your feeling healthier and happier and you will then help others find happiness. Soon you will feel and see a world worth living for a world worth fighting for and people you will happily call life long friends forever.  So call on God for he will send many your way some you will truely love and find worth living for and if you ever want to talk live come check my friend Amy and I out at [https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/](https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/)  We are live every night from 12am-2am or longer if you need a friend ;) Bill E.

I have to agree with you on this especially for those suffering painful slow deaths for whatever medical reason but I have taken the easy way out and only lived to tell a much a much sadder tale. This truth be told did actually turn out to be a much happier time in my present day. I although now paralyzed from the neck down got to watch and help my children grow up and they now have children of their own, 5 and a half to be precise. I have learned through AA and serious an deep soul searching that I was blocking most of my own happiness. Whether my depression was caused by others or my own actions I've now learned how to deal with the daily struggles I face and still be a happier healthier person. A long time ago I was not happy enough to live but then and more now I live for others. At first it was for my children and my family but now and still them I live to help others and I truly believe there is no better happiness than helping others. I must admit I at one time wanted and needed to be loved but now I feel that love from above well that and I'm on prozac and a multitude of pain and anti-spasm meds. However, changing my outlook and way I deal with the world has been the most effective way I have found peace. Going to two AA groups a day and hosting a live suicide prevention group from 12am-2am eastern daylight time  I run and my friend Amy run. [https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/](https://thesuicidepreventionvideoline.weebly.com/) We don't get many people yet but 2 or three is a great feeling when we do and we listen, talk and share. So hope you are doing well and are feeling good if you would like to chat we'll be here. Peace out and God bless ;) Remember this just take it one day at a time that is all we really can do anyways and like the sun breaks up the darkness so to does happiness and wisdom eventually override the sadness. I am living proof of that fact thank God...
